findings.failure_scenario: When `CONVEX_URL` is absent in production, API requests use a process-local run store. Run records disappear on restart and are not shared across instances, so run state is silently lost.
findings.suggestion: Could a missing Convex configuration return an explicit unavailable error instead of selecting the in-memory store?

findings.failure_scenario: When `CONVEX_URL` is missing in production, run data is stored only in process memory and disappears on restart or across instances, while the API continues operating as though persistence were available.
findings.suggestion: Could this return an explicit configuration error instead of keeping the in-memory fallback in the production adapter?

findings.failure_scenario: When `CONVEX_URL` is unset in a production deployment, the adapter accepts a run write into process memory and reports success. A restart or another instance then has no record, while the PR description says operation continues without Convex.
findings.suggestion: Could the production adapter return an explicit unavailable error when Convex is not configured, reserving the memory store for tests?
